# Settings reference

<!-- Generated by `bogey docs` from packages/config/src/settings.ts. Do not edit manually. -->

Settings live in the database and resolve Bogey's defaults → instance → organization → event;
a level can lock keys for the levels below. Edit them in the app (Instance, Organization and
event pages). See [configuration](../configuration.md) for the other tiers.

## Branding (`branding`)

Set at: instance, org, event.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | text | `brand.name` in bogey.config.ts | Name shown in the header and emails |
| `shortName` | text | — | Shorter name for tight spaces |
| `accent` | text | — | Accent color |
| `fallbackMessage` | text | — | Markdown shown on the not-found and error pages |

## Registration (`registration`)

Set at: instance, org, event.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `signup` | `open` · `invite` · `closed` | `invite` | Who can create an account |
| `capacity` | whole number (0 to 100000) | `0` | How many participants an event takes; later registrations join the waitlist. 0 has no limit |
| `autoPromote` | on / off | `true` | Move the next person on the waitlist in when a place opens |
| `mode` | `open` · `review` · `invite` | `invite` | How event registrations are handled: approved at once, reviewed, or invite links only |

## Email (`email`)

Set at: instance, org, event.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `senderName` | text | — | Sender name on sign-in emails |
| `templates` | text | — | Subject and Markdown body of emails Bogey sends |
| `layout` | text | — | The HTML every email is rendered into; only the instance's counts |

## Tenancy (`tenancy`)

Set at: instance.

Only the operator sets `appUrl` for the instance, in [bogey.config.ts](../configuration.md#keys-only-the-file-sets) or with the CLI; admins can't change it in the app.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `defaultOrg` | text | — | Org used when a host matches no domain |
| `appUrl` | text | — | Where the database reaches this app to send queued email, e.g. https://hacks.example.com |

## Accounts (`accounts`)

Set at: instance.

Only the operator sets `requireAdminMfa`, `deviceSignOut`, `maxPasskeys` for the instance, in [bogey.config.ts](../configuration.md#keys-only-the-file-sets) or with the CLI; admins can't change it in the app.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `portfolios` | on / off | `false` | People can have a public page at /@handle with their projects and awards |
| `deletionRequests` | on / off | `true` | Let people ask for their account to be deleted from Account settings |
| `requireAdminMfa` | on / off | `true` | Instance admins need an authenticator app before they can use Instance pages |
| `deviceSignOut` | on / off | `false` | People can sign out one of their other devices, or all of them, from Account |
| `maxPasskeys` | whole number (0 to 9) | `5` | How many passkeys one person can add; 0 turns passkeys off |

## Sign-in methods (`signin`)

Set at: instance, org.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `providers` | list | `[]` | Sign-in providers offered besides email. An organization's list narrows the instance's |

## Audit log (`audit`)

Set at: instance, org.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `retentionDays` | whole number (30 to 3650) | `60` | Days to keep audit entries |

## Network access (`access`)

Set at: org, event.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowedNetworks` | list | `[]` | Participants can only take part in the event from these networks; empty allows any |
| `networkAreas` | list | — | Where the networks apply: sessions, teams, messages, submissions, voting or a plugin's area (plugin.area); empty is everywhere |
| `onlyUsers` | list | `[]` | Limit only these people to the networks; with no teams or divisions, everyone |
| `onlyTeams` | list | `[]` | Limit only the members of these teams to the networks |
| `onlyDivisions` | list | `[]` | Limit only the members of these divisions to the networks |

## Client IPs (`network`)

Set at: instance.

Only the operator sets `clientIpHeader`, `trustedHops`, `trustedProxies` for the instance, in [bogey.config.ts](../configuration.md#keys-only-the-file-sets) or with the CLI; admins can't change it in the app.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clientIpHeader` | `x-forwarded-for` · `cf-connecting-ip` · `x-real-ip` | `x-forwarded-for` | Where the database reads a visitor's IP |
| `trustedHops` | whole number (1 to 10) | `1` | Proxies in front of Supabase that append to X-Forwarded-For |
| `trustedProxies` | list | `[]` | The app server's addresses, whose forwarded visitor IP is trusted |

## Search engines (`seo`)

Set at: instance, org.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `indexing` | on / off | `true` | Let search engines list public pages |
| `description` | text | — | Description for search results and link previews |

## Limits (`limits`)

Set at: instance.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `eventsPerOrg` | whole number (0 to 100000) | — | Most events one organization can have |
| `adminsPerOrg` | whole number (0 to 100000) | — | Most owners and admins one organization can have |
| `participantsPerEvent` | whole number (0 to 1000000) | — | Most participants one event can have |
| `emailsPerDay` | whole number (0 to 10000000) | — | Most emails Bogey sends for one organization in a day |
| `storageMbPerOrg` | whole number (0 to 100000000) | — | Most megabytes of uploads one organization can keep |
| `maxUploadMb` | whole number (0 to 10000) | — | Largest single file, in megabytes, anyone in one organization can upload |
| `customDomainsPerOrg` | whole number (0 to 1000) | — | Most hostnames one organization can have |
| `pendingInvitesPerOrg` | whole number (0 to 100000) | — | Most open invite links one organization can have |

## Submissions (`submissions`)

Set at: instance, org, event.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `autoSubmit` | on / off | `false` | Submit complete drafts when submissions close |
| `maxTracks` | whole number (1 to 40) | — | Most prizes a team can enter its project in; unset means any number |
| `reminderHours` | whole number (0 to 336) | `24` | Remind teams that only have a draft this many hours before submissions close; 0 sends none |
| `publicToggle` | on / off | `false` | Whether teams can choose to hide their submission from the public gallery |
| `deletion` | `none` · `request` · `allow` | `allow` | Whether teams can delete their submissions, or ask organizers to |
| `submittedTitle` | text | — | The heading teams see once their project is submitted |
| `submittedBody` | text | — | The line under it; {when} becomes when they submitted |
| `prizePrompt` | text | — | What teams read above the prizes they can enter |
| `prizeImage` | `icon` · `banner` | — | Whether a prize's image is a small icon beside it or a banner across it |

Set at: instance, org, event.

Set at: instance, org, event.

## Check-in (`checkin`)

Set at: instance, org, event.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `takers` | list | `["organizer","staff"]` | Roles, or tags (tag:<id>), that work the check-in desk and take attendance in sessions; organizers always can |
| `confirmName` | on / off | `true` | Show each person's name at the desk so staff can check it against ID |
| `allowWalkIns` | on / off | `false` | Let staff register and check in people who aren't on the roster |
| `badgeEmailHours` | whole number (0 to 336) | `24` | Email each person their check-in code this many hours before the event starts; 0 sends none |
| `selfCheckIn` | on / off | — | Let people check themselves in with the venue code staff show on a screen |
| `requiredToCompete` | on / off | `false` | Participants can't change teams, submit or vote until they've checked in |

## Gallery (`gallery`)

Set at: instance, org, event.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layout` | `grid` · `lanes` | — | How the gallery lays out projects: an even grid, or lanes that pack tightly |
| `switchLayout` | on / off | — | Whether visitors can switch the layout for themselves |
| `banners` | on / off | `true` | Show a banner image on each project's card |
| `teamBanners` | on / off | `true` | Whether teams choose their own banner from their project's images |
| `teamSizes` | on / off | `false` | Whether teams choose how large their card is |
| `winners` | on / off | `true` | Mark award winners in the gallery once results are published |
| `likes` | on / off | `false` | Let signed-in visitors like projects |
| `comments` | on / off | `false` | Let signed-in visitors comment on projects |
| `sort` | `newest` · `oldest` · `title` · `team` · `winners` · `liked` · `votes` · `discussed` · `random` | `newest` | How projects are ordered until a visitor picks another order |
| `slideshow` | on / off | `true` | Offer the slideshow |

## Popular vote (`voting`)

Set at: instance, org, event.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | on / off | `false` | Let people vote for their favorite projects |
| `who` | `participants` · `members` · `signedIn` | `participants` | Who can vote: participants, everyone in the event, or anyone signed in |
| `votesPerPerson` | whole number (1 to 20) | `1` | How many projects one person can vote for |
| `ownTeam` | on / off | `false` | Whether teams can vote for their own project |
| `showCounts` | on / off | `false` | Show vote counts while voting is open; otherwise only once results are published |

## Judging (`judging`)

Set at: instance, org, event.

| Key | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blind` | on / off | `false` | Hide team names from judges |
| `normalize` | `none` · `minmax` · `zscore` | `none` | How judges' scores are put on a common scale before they are combined |
| `minJudges` | whole number (1 to 20) | `2` | Fewest judges an entry should have before results are published |
| `shareWithTeams` | `none` · `feedback` · `scores` | `feedback` | What teams see from judges once results are published |
| `showRankings` | `organizers` · `everyone` | `organizers` | Who sees the full ranking when results are published; awards are always public |
| `judgeRubric` | on / off | `true` | Judges can pick or change a project's rubric |
| `judgeDivision` | on / off | `true` | Judges can move a project to another division |
| `teamRubric` | on / off | `false` | Teams pick their own rubric on their submission |
| `teamRubricShows` | `name` · `criteria` | `name` | What teams see of the rubrics they pick from |
| `deliberation` | `off` · `assigned` · `all` | `assigned` | Who discusses a flagged project |
| `flagGap` | whole number (0 to 100) | `0` | Flag a project when its judges' totals are further apart than this (0 is off) |
| `holdFlagged` | on / off | `true` | Results can't be published while a project is flagged |
| `judgeExport` | `off` · `projects` · `results` | `off` | What judges can download in the projects spreadsheet |
| `demoJudges` | on / off | — | Show teams which judges sit on the panel they present their demo to |
| `browseProjects` | on / off | — | Judges with assignments can also open and score projects outside them |
| `assignment` | group | `{"perProject":1,"rules":[],"exclude":[]}` | How Assign judges picks: judges per project, rules asking for judges with a tag, and tags kept out |
| `tiebreakers` | list | `[]` | What decides between projects with the same score, in order: a criterion, the score before evening out judges, more judges, or submitted first |
| `advanceTies` | on / off | `true` | Advancing the top N also takes every project still tied with the last one |
| `guide` | group | — | A PDF judges can read beside each project, stored in the submissions bucket |
